prompt: When a handler sets a Transfer-Encoding header (e.g. `res.set('Transfer-Encoding', 'chunked').send('hello')`), res.send() no longer generates an ETag for the response. Content-Length is correctly omitted in that case since the two headers must not be combined, but the ETag is also silently skipped, so conditional GET/304 handling stops working for such responses. Expected: the response has Transfer-Encoding and no Content-Length, and still carries the normal weak ETag computed from the body (for 'hello' that is W/"5-qvTGHdzF6KLavt4PO0gs2a6pQ00").
fail_to_pass: npx mocha --require test/support/env --check-leaks test/res.send.js -g 'should still generate an ETag'
pass_to_pass: npx mocha --require test/support/env --check-leaks test/res.send.js test/res.json.js -g 'should still generate an ETag' --invert
